import sys, json, copy, random
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from harness import run
from fuzz2 import gen_request, ROUTES

rng = random.Random(99)
fails = []

def build_events(req, mut=None):
    fields = copy.deepcopy(req['fields'])
    trailers = copy.deepcopy(req['trailers']) if req['trailers'] is not None else None
    body = req['body']
    if mut: mut(fields, trailers, req)
    events = [{'sid':0,'type':'headers','fields':fields}]
    if body: events.append({'sid':0,'type':'data','hex':body.hex()})
    if trailers is not None: events.append({'sid':0,'type':'headers','fields':trailers})
    events.append({'sid':0,'type':'fin'})
    return events

def setpseudo(f, name, value):
    for i,(n,v) in enumerate(f):
        if n == name: f[i] = [name, value]; return
    f.append([name, value])

def dup_existing_singleton(f, t, r):
    singles = [(n,v) for n,v in f if not n.startswith(':') and n not in
               ('accept','accept-encoding','cache-control','if-match','if-none-match','pragma','vary',
                'cookie','content-length','te','host') and not n.startswith('x-list-')]
    if singles: f.append(list(singles[0]))
    else: f.append(['zz-dup','1']); f.append(['zz-dup','1'])

MUST_REJECT = [
 ('dup-singleton', dup_existing_singleton),
 ('dup-new', lambda f,t,r: (f.append(['x-new','1']), f.append(['x-new','1'])) and None),
 ('bad-method', lambda f,t,r: setpseudo(f,':method','TRACE')),
 ('bad-method2', lambda f,t,r: setpseudo(f,':method','get')),
 ('bad-scheme', lambda f,t,r: setpseudo(f,':scheme','ftp')),
 ('prohibited-conn', lambda f,t,r: f.append(['connection','close'])),
 ('prohibited-upgrade', lambda f,t,r: f.append(['upgrade','h2c'])),
 ('prohibited-trailer', lambda f,t,r: f.append(['trailer','x-audit-a'])),
 ('prohibited-te-h2', lambda f,t,r: f.append(['http2-settings','x'])),
 ('prohibited-keepalive', lambda f,t,r: f.append(['keep-alive',''])),
 ('prohibited-proxyconn', lambda f,t,r: f.append(['proxy-connection',''])),
 ('prohibited-tenegotiate', lambda f,t,r: f.append(['transfer-encoding','chunked'])),
 ('bad-te', lambda f,t,r: f.append(['te','gzip'])),
 ('dup-te', lambda f,t,r: (f.append(['te','trailers']), f.append(['te','trailers'])) and None),
 ('cl-mismatch', lambda f,t,r: f.append(['content-length', str(len(r['body'])+1)])),
 ('cl-empty', lambda f,t,r: f.append(['content-length', ''])),
 ('cl-x', lambda f,t,r: f.append(['content-length', 'x'])),
 ('cl-negative', lambda f,t,r: f.append(['content-length', '-1'])),
 ('cl-float', lambda f,t,r: f.append(['content-length', '1.0'])),
 ('cl-hex', lambda f,t,r: f.append(['content-length', '0x10'])),
 ('cl-diff-members', lambda f,t,r: f.append(['content-length', '1, 2'])),
 ('path-doubleslash', lambda f,t,r: setpseudo(f,':path','//a')),
 ('path-space', lambda f,t,r: setpseudo(f,':path','/a b')),
 ('path-frag', lambda f,t,r: setpseudo(f,':path','/a#b')),
 ('path-percent', lambda f,t,r: setpseudo(f,':path','/a%2')),
 ('path-empty', lambda f,t,r: setpseudo(f,':path','')),
 ('path-backslash', lambda f,t,r: setpseudo(f,':path','/a\\b')),
 ('path-nonascii', lambda f,t,r: setpseudo(f,':path','/a\u00e9')),
 ('path-absolute', lambda f,t,r: setpseudo(f,':path','https://demo.test/')),
 ('auth-unrouted', lambda f,t,r: setpseudo(f,':authority','nowhere.test')),
 ('auth-bracketless-v6', lambda f,t,r: setpseudo(f,':authority','2001:db8::1')),
 ('auth-port-0', lambda f,t,r: setpseudo(f,':authority','demo.test:0')),
 ('auth-port-big', lambda f,t,r: setpseudo(f,':authority','demo.test:999999')),
 ('auth-port-signed', lambda f,t,r: setpseudo(f,':authority','demo.test:+80')),
 ('auth-empty', lambda f,t,r: setpseudo(f,':authority','')),
 ('auth-trailing-dot', lambda f,t,r: setpseudo(f,':authority','demo.test.')),
 ('auth-underscore', lambda f,t,r: setpseudo(f,':authority','demo_test')),
 ('pseudo-late', lambda f,t,r: f.append([':path','/x'])),
 ('pseudo-dup', lambda f,t,r: f.append([':method','GET'])),
 ('pseudo-unknown', lambda f,t,r: f.insert(0, [':protocol','x'])),
 ('drop-method', lambda f,t,r: [f.remove(p) for p in list(f) if p[0]==':method'] and None),
 ('drop-scheme', lambda f,t,r: [f.remove(p) for p in list(f) if p[0]==':scheme'] and None),
 ('value-cr', lambda f,t,r: f.append(['x-zz','a\r\nb'])),
 ('value-nul', lambda f,t,r: f.append(['x-zz','a\x00b'])),
 ('value-del', lambda f,t,r: f.append(['x-zz','a\x7fb'])),
 ('value-leadsp', lambda f,t,r: f.append(['x-zz',' a'])),
 ('value-trailsp', lambda f,t,r: f.append(['x-zz','a '])),
 ('name-upper', lambda f,t,r: f.append(['X-Zz','a'])),
 ('name-empty', lambda f,t,r: f.append(['','a'])),
 ('name-nonascii', lambda f,t,r: f.append(['x-\u00e9','a'])),
 ('host-dup', lambda f,t,r: (f.append(['host','other.test']), f.append(['host','other.test'])) and None),
 ('auth-host-conflict', lambda f,t,r: f.append(['host','conflict.test'])),
 ('trailer-badname', lambda f,t,r: t is not None and t.append(['x-nope','1'])),
 ('trailer-pseudo', lambda f,t,r: t is not None and t.append([':method','GET'])),
 ('trailer-bare', lambda f,t,r: t is not None and t.append(['x-audit-','1'])),
 ('trailer-upper', lambda f,t,r: t is not None and t.append(['X-AUDIT-A','1'])),
 ('trailer-cookie', lambda f,t,r: t is not None and t.append(['cookie','a=1'])),
]

MUST_FORWARD = [
 ('add-te', lambda f,t,r: f.append(['te','trailers'])),
 ('add-repeat', lambda f,t,r: (f.append(['accept','a']), f.append(['accept','b'])) and None),
 ('add-xlist', lambda f,t,r: (f.append(['x-list-q','a']), f.append(['x-list-q','b'])) and None),
 ('add-cookie', lambda f,t,r: (f.append(['cookie','a=1']), f.append(['cookie','b=2'])) and None),
 ('cl-leading-zeros', lambda f,t,r: f.append(['content-length','0'*10+str(len(r['body']))])),
 ('cl-list-same', lambda f,t,r: f.append(['content-length','%d, %d, %s' % (len(r['body']), len(r['body']), '0'*5+str(len(r['body'])))])),
 ('empty-value', lambda f,t,r: f.append(['x-zz',''])),
 ('high-value', lambda f,t,r: f.append(['x-zz','\u00e9\u00ff'])),
 ('inner-tab', lambda f,t,r: f.append(['x-zz','a\tb'])),
 ('trailer-extra', lambda f,t,r: t is not None and t.append(['x-audit-zzz','1'])),
 ('trailer-dup', lambda f,t,r: t is not None and t.append(['x-audit-a','again'])),
]

n_rej = n_fwd = 0
for it in range(40):
    req = gen_request(rng)
    reqT = copy.deepcopy(req); reqT['trailers'] = [['x-audit-a','1']]
    for name, mut in MUST_REJECT:
        use = reqT if name.startswith('trailer') else req
        ev = build_events(use, mut)
        st = run({'routes':ROUTES,'events':ev})['streams'][0]['status']
        if st != 'rejected':
            fails.append('REJECT %s iter %d -> %s' % (name, it, st))
    n_rej += 1
    for name, mut in MUST_FORWARD:
        use = reqT if name.startswith('trailer') else req
        ev = build_events(use, mut)
        st = run({'routes':ROUTES,'events':ev})['streams'][0]['status']
        if st != 'forwarded':
            fails.append('FWD %s iter %d -> %s' % (name, it, st))
            print(json.dumps(ev[:1])[:400])
    n_fwd += 1
print('iters', n_rej, 'fails', len(fails))
for f in fails[:25]: print(' -', f)
